title: Mint Crop & Patterned Trousers
prompt: An original young woman with light brown hair in two low buns stands against a gray studio backdrop. She wears a sheer pale mint long-sleeve crop top with a lace-ribbon bodice and multi-strand chains with a heart pendant. Patterned olive wide-leg trousers have a knotted sash at the waist with purple flowers. She carries an orange crossbody bag and wears white canvas sneakers. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of mint, olive, and orange. Playful and nostalgic, in the style of a 2000s Y2K lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The mint crop and patterned trousers are the signature pairing.
- Keep the gray backdrop for a clean studio look.
